preferences.preference: Hotel room quality and staff service
preferences.description: Travelers value clean rooms, good value, and helpful staff service during their hotel stays across Bangladesh.
Travelers enjoy scenic sea views, marine biodiversity, and peaceful getaways at popular coastal destinations and islands.

preferences.preference: Historic landmarks and archaeological site visits
preferences.description: Travelers explore Bangladesh's rich past by visiting iconic historical landmarks, ancient architectural wonders, and UNESCO World Heritage sites.
Travelers experience panoramic mountain landscapes, cloud-touching elevations, and viewpoints like Nilachal in Bandarban.
Travelers discover the ancient architecture and ghost-town ambiance of 19th-century merchant mansions in Panam City, Sonargaon.

preferences.preference: Sreemangal tea gardens and nature tours
preferences.description: Travelers visit lush green tea gardens and rolling hills to enjoy peaceful nature getaways and local tea tasting.
Travelers enjoy unique boat ride experiences and scenic flooded forest views at Ratargul Swamp Forest in Sylhet.
Travelers experience accessible mangrove ecosystems and wildlife viewing via short-duration day trips to Karamjal.

preferences.preference: Kaptai Lake and Rangamati scenic tours
preferences.description: Travelers admire the breathtaking natural beauty, peaceful waters, and scenic landscapes of Kaptai Lake and Rangamati.

preferences.preference: General historical monuments and museum visits
preferences.description: Travelers visit significant historical sites and ancient monuments to learn about local history and view historical architecture.
